Compare a message with the reply to it. List each concrete thing the message asks for that the reply neither handles, starts, plans nor talks about. Ignore musings and anything the reply asked back about.
Answer with exactly NONE, or one line per missed thing starting "- ", quoting the message's own words.

<message>
ok brain dump before i forget, hub stuff first. inbox rows r still too tall on the laptop. the settings page scrolls weird. want a shortcut for a new chat. terminal font is tiny. notes shud sync between windows. let me pin a chat to the top. the rail badge doesnt clear after i answer something. today shud show what finished overnight at the top. make the send button not jump when the text wraps. teh model picker forgets my pick after restart. add a little undo after archive. dark mode the code blocks r unreadable. search in a chat would be nice. being built list shud group by project not by time. the archive button sits too close to delete. and the dock icon badge is wrong half the time
</message>

<reply>
Sixteen hub things, in the order you said them. I'm capturing them as you said them, then I'll start the ones that don't need a call from you.

1. Inbox rows are still too tall on the laptop.
2. The settings page scrolls weird.
3. A shortcut for a new chat.
4. Terminal font is tiny.
5. Notes should sync between windows.
6. Pin a chat to the top.
7. The rail badge doesn't clear after you answer something.
8. Today should show what finished overnight at the top.
9. The send button jumps when the text wraps.
10. The model picker forgets your pick after restart.
11. A little undo after archive.
12. Dark mode code blocks are unreadable.
13. Search in a chat.
14. Being built list should group by project, not by time.
15. The archive button sits too close to delete.
16. The dock icon badge is wrong half the time.

Starting now: capture all sixteen, then the layout and badge fixes that don't depend on a key choice (inbox row height, settings scroll, terminal font, send button jump, archive-too-close-to-delete, dark code blocks, rail badge, dock badge). Grouping Being built by project is your call already, so that goes with them.

Needs the user: which shortcut for a new chat?
My pick: Cmd+N.
</reply>
